professionalSummary.text: Candidate has deployed ranking changes to the production search service and operates production relevance monitoring.
professionalSummary.witness: Coordinated releases with the platform team through the release review; ranking changes were deployed to the production search service by the platform team, and the live relevance dashboards were owned and monitored by the platform's search operations engineer.

experienceHighlights.text: Candidate has developed and evaluated ranking models offline against the labelled query set.
experienceHighlights.witness: Developed and evaluated ranking models for the reporting system's search service offline against the labelled query set (about 3,400 finance queries), improving offline nDCG in three consecutive model iterations.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Candidate has built the offline evaluation harness and the replay tool for the search service.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Built the offline evaluation harness and the replay tool that scores a ranking model against logged queries copied from the production index into the development cluster.

skills.text: Candidate has documented model cards, known limitations and hand-over conditions for each ranking release.
skills.witness: Wrote the model card for each ranking iteration, listing the training queries, the offline metrics and the known limitation that document-type boosts were tuned only on logged queries, plus the hand-over notes for the platform team.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish that the candidate has deployed ranking changes to the production search service, operated production relevance monitoring, developed and evaluated ranking models offline, built the offline evaluation harness and replay tool, and documented model cards. They do not establish that the candidate ran live-traffic experiments with the platform team or coordinated releases with the finance-user team.
